subject: Re: CKD kickoff — hallucination-resistant captioning via contrastive distillation
body:
Decision time ahead of the Aug 3 go/no-go.

Full-data distillation results came in: adversarial POPE +5.4 (71.2 → 76.6), random split +1.9, and Wei was right — the CIDEr cost dropped to 0.3 with distillation weight at 0.5. I'll take that trade every day of the week.

Decisions:
1) GO for product integration review on Aug 3. Fumiko prepares the eval pack; both product surfaces have asked for the adversarial-split breakdown.
2) The synthetic-data pipeline gets kept and documented as a deliverable in its own right — Wanjiru writes the runbook so it survives the team moving on.
3) Scope cut: the GQA-based eval extension moves to Q4; POPE on VG+COCO is enough for the integration decision.

Lucia
